title: Deriving ordinary coefficient squares with their full units
statement: Given additive F:A→B and G:C→D between abelian categories, independently sized derived categories on A,B and C,D, exact equivalences U:A→C and V:B→D, right-derived models RF,RG as in [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit], and an ordinary isomorphism F V≅U G, there exists ExactSquareOfUniverses with the full universal-unit normalization of [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models]. Consequently an ordinary normalized coefficient square between CompletedRealizations of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference] yields a CompletedPushSquare with precisely that ordinary comparison and normalized derived square.

source.place: paragraph (1), coefficient/direct-image comparison; Stacks Tags 05RR and 0941

proof.text: The two right-derived units are universal left Kan extensions. Transport them through the two exact equivalences. Uniqueness of the transported universal pairs supplies the right-derived isomorphism, with its full factorization equation on every complex. Package this with the supplied ordinary square; the universal-unit equation determines the choice up to the equality used downstream.

theorem diagonalExactSquare_exists
    {A B C D : Type a} [Category.{v} A] [Category.{v} B]
    [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v} D] [Abelian A] [Abelian B] [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} D]
    (F : A ⥤ B) (G : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    (U : A ⥤ C) (V : B ⥤ D) [U.Additive] [V.Additive]
    [U.IsEquivalence] [V.IsEquivalence]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits U] [PreservesFiniteColimits U]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits V] [PreservesFiniteColimits V]
    (RF : DiagonalRightDerived F) (RG : DiagonalRightDerived G)
    (ordinary : F ⋙ V ≅ U ⋙ G) :
    Nonempty (DiagonalTrace.ExactSquareOfUniverses F G U V RF RG ordinary)
